notes: «وجده، من قبل أمه أبو ذباب» is one link named Abu Dhubab (rule 7), a co-transmitter of Iyas at the same level; «عن جده» at the end is a bare relation.
Whether the Iyas route stops at Iyas or runs on through Abu Dhubab's «عن جده» is not settled by the text; the reading writes the grandfather level for both routes.
